Trinity S³AI

A trit in two bits, and the code nobody uses

Binary hardware stores a trit in two bits: -1 as 00, 0 as 01, +1 as 10. The fourth code, 11, means nothing: a quarter of the codes are wasted.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.
